async def act(page):
    import asyncio
    # Click the Catalog link to navigate to the product catalog
    catalog_link = page.get_by_role("menubar").get_by_role("link", name="\ue648 Catalog", exact=True)
    await catalog_link.wait_for(state="visible")
    await catalog_link.click()
    # Wait for navigation to the catalog page by checking for a catalog-specific element
    try:
        # Wait for an element that is likely on the catalog page, e.g., a search input or product grid
        await page.wait_for_selector("input[name='fulltext']", timeout=30000)
    except:
        # If that element doesn't appear, wait for network idle and check URL
        await page.wait_for_load_state("networkidle")
        current_url = page.url
        if "catalog" not in current_url.lower():
            # If still not on catalog page, log error and stop
            print("Failed to navigate to catalog page. Current URL:", current_url)
            return
    # After successful navigation, no further actions in this step
    pass
